name: smart-compact
description: Compaction that keeps what matters and costs less: Haiku writes a structured summary (user instructions, decisions, exact identifiers, open errors, next step) instead of your main model, recent messages are kept whole, and a handoff file is saved.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: haiku: Haiku writes a structured summary and recent messages stay whole (falls back to the built-in summary on any failure). steer: the built-in summarizer runs, told to use the same structure. off: built-in compaction untouched.

keepRecentMessages.title: Recent messages kept whole
keepRecentMessages.description: At least this many of the latest messages stay word for word after compaction (haiku mode).

writeHandoff.title: Save summary to .claude/handoff.md
writeHandoff.description: Also write the summary to a file you can start a fresh session from.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact early at % of context
compactAtPercent.description: Compact on its own once context passes this percent, so later turns are cheaper. 0 leaves it to Claude Code's own threshold.
